items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: I had him mixed up with what I'm telling you, but we usually call him Fu Klo.

ctx.x: Let's see. Cook shop. I think I'm kind of mixed up on that. Cook shop son is the one I was trying to have that kazoo.
Yeah, you mentioned him. Yeah, you mentioned him. I had him mixed up with what I'm telling you, but we usually call him Fu Klo.

Fu Klo? Yeah, Sun. There's Fu Klo that's still playing. Robert Lewis, is that his name, plays bass drum. Sun Fu Klo. Yeah, he's still playing. There's another one they call Sun on the drums. So Fu Klo was kind of tall.
